scope: Current Administration/Configuration/Feature Administration/Release Notes and relevant product-specific guides were searched for each mandatory target. Documentation discovery drove topic selection after the historical inventory existed.

products.feature_source: EDM templates, external data feeds, 32-column CSV/TXT source, All/Any field matching, deep inspection requirements, DLP sensor/profile/policy flow.

guide_corpus: FortiManager 7.6.1 CLI Reference: admin and system admin
products.feature_source: Remote GUI Access admin-profile permission, Device Manager context action, TCP/8082 proxy port, FGFM management relationship and FortiGate login.
Status derived from OFTP connectivity and last-log receipt; 15-minute near-real-time and 6-hour scheduled-upload default thresholds; log rate and disk quota views.
PSK and dynamic CAK MACsec, PAE modes, RADIUS-derived MSK/CAK, MKA/SAK rekey, cipher suites, replay protection, traffic policy and oversubscription caveats.
Supported FortiAP models as LoRaWAN gateways; Basics Station or UDP Packet Forwarder; CUPS configuration/update/certificates and TC/LNS data endpoint; WTP profile binding and cw_diag verification.
Roles for users, hosts, devices and ports; role rank and first-match precedence; group, captive portal, user inheritance, manual and device-profiler assignment.

Signed GA firmware, boot-time/runtime file integrity hashes, trusted upgrade/downgrade boundaries, air-gapped verification. Release notes are the authoritative feature source; direct page fetch was blocked.

Certificate Management > Policies > General; the default-enabled Delete user certificate's private key once downloaded option removes FortiAuthenticator-generated user private keys after Export Key Cert PKCS#12 download. End Entities > Users provides the corresponding Export Key Cert operation.
products.selected_lesson: One-time private-key delivery: deleting a user certificate key after PKCS#12 download

products.feature_source: Multiple Target Address field is exclusive with Target Address/URL; supports IP ranges, CIDR, FQDN and wildcard FQDN; target allowlist and launcher destination selection.
Headless Windows Agent direct Collector deployment, no Supervisor registration, local JSON template, Collector-side credentials, supported event sources and licensing.
Agentless ZTNA configuration workflow: proxy, proxy SSO, user groups, Private Access security profile, SPA hub, private application, geofencing and bookmark portal.

guide_corpus: SD-WAN aggregate static IPsec tunnel example
products.feature_source: Parallel static IPsec phase1 interfaces with aggregate-member enabled, ipsec-aggregate interface, SD-WAN membership and per-packet load balancing.

limitations: Fortinet Document Library pages were indexed and their source text was available in search excerpts, but direct page opening returned HTTP 403 for several URLs. The report identifies those limitations and does not claim full direct-page inspection.
FortiNAC-F Secure Boot detail is documented primarily in 7.6.3 release notes and signed-image upgrade documentation; no separate administration-guide chapter was located.
FortiSASE Outpost was found in product/news material but a sufficiently detailed administration/architecture guide was not located, so it was not selected as a primary lesson.

Only one directly matched Community scenario was verified within the 30-day window (FortiAnalyzer post-reboot Device Manager status). Other selected lessons use official feature documentation with older, unrelated or no scenario companion.
